::: callout-note
An entry in the table means:

-   **Lectures**: watch the recorded lectures, complete the worksheet, and bring it in to the weekly meeting (i.e. Wednesday, 09:45 am).
-   **Milestones:** upload the presentation slides by 10:00 on the Monday before the weekly meeting. Attend the weekly meeting for milestone presentation & discussion.
-   **Workbench:** weekly workbench sessions (i.e., Friday, 11:30) where we talk more about practical EEG processing. For the second half of the semester when no workbench sessions are scheduled, this time is used for individual project meetings.
-   **Learning opportunities:** the optional exercises that help you better understand the concepts and practice the skills you will apply in your own projects.
:::
